newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - April 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - April 18.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Friday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- Parliament passes bill mandating use of land for U.S. military in Okinawa.
-- Former South Korean presidents Chun Doo-hwan and Roh Tae-woo lose appeals in South Korea's Supreme Court.
-- Science and Technology Agency reprimands three governmental officials over nuclear accident in Tokaimura, northeast of Tokyo.
-- Panel on fiscal structural reform to propose 10 percent cut in public works spending in the year to March 31, 1999.
